maddeler.e:
أضطلع (form VIII)
# أَضْطَلِعُ (ʔaḍṭaliʕu) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.li.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِضْطَلَعَ (iḍṭalaʕa)
# أَضْطَلِعَ (ʔaḍṭaliʕa) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.li.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَلَعَ (iḍṭalaʕa)
# أَضْطَلِعْ (ʔaḍṭaliʕ) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.liʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِضْطَلَعَ (iḍṭalaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
